name: Larkspur
description: A single-file H5 festival planner whose world model is a set of intervals. Every act is a start, an end and a stage, so a plan can be wrong in two ways the app can prove: a clash, where two sets overlap, and a tight change, where the gap between them is shorter than the walk between their stages. The walking times are a real matrix — six minutes from the Chapel to the Sidecar, twenty from the Meadow — so a fifteen minute gap is comfortable in one direction and impossible in another. 6 screens, 16 acts over two days, 4 stages, a per-day timeline and a clash list that suggests which act to drop.

finish.answer: final answer for question tasks; optional for action tasks

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — the timeline prints stage by stage, and every clash and tight change is spelled out with the minutes involved.
observation.pixels: 390x844 screenshot (browser backend); __ENV__.bounds() maps every test-id to a pixel box
observation.state: engine.snapshot(state) — canonical state plus a derived view listing the faults by name. For the verifier only.

world.clash: two acts in the plan whose times overlap by even a minute
world.tight: no overlap, but the gap is shorter than the walk between the two stages
world.walk: Meadow-Barn 8, Meadow-Chapel 14, Meadow-Sidecar 20, Barn-Chapel 9, Barn-Sidecar 12, Chapel-Sidecar 6
world.seeded: Friday holds three acts and no faults; Saturday is empty
